en: Invite friends to this game. Instagram copies the invitation for you to paste into a message or story. No video is included.
zh: 邀请朋友来玩这个游戏。Instagram 入口会复制邀请文案，方便你粘贴到私信或快拍中。此链接不包含视频。

en: Copy the invitation, then open Instagram
zh: 复制邀请文案，然后打开 Instagram

en: Open X with your invitation prefilled
zh: 打开 X 并填入邀请文案

en: Review and send your invitation on {0}.
zh: 在 {0} 中确认并发送邀请。

en: Invitation copied. Paste it into your {0} message or post, then review and send it there.
zh: 邀请文案已复制。粘贴到 {0} 的私信或帖子中，确认后发送。

en: Select and copy the invitation above. Automatic copying is unavailable.
zh: 请选择并复制上方邀请文案，当前无法自动复制。

en: Sharing is unavailable. Copy the invitation instead.
zh: 当前无法使用系统分享，请复制邀请文案。
